files/upload-duplicate.note:
As part of the stateful upload card revamp, we must offer the options to Replace, Keep both, and Skip within the corresponding row on the uploads card. As of right now, no options are shown. 

We also must start supporting uploading entire folders, and we need to be careful to smoothly handle folders that are part problematic, continuing to process non-problematic files even if a problematic one is encounter. This should show in the form of parallel execution, with the progress still being shown and advancing while the decision is offered, and, if multiple files need decisions, we should have something that says "14 more problems ->" or similar.

files/upload-slow.note:
Progress bar did not move. Leaving the page with the upload running did not ask first, but I saw the file uploaded toast anyway, and the file successfully. Here's what needs to change:

a) Figure out why the progress bar isn't moving. Could be an issue with the test harness.
b) We will make the uploads panel universal through the file explorer. When I navigate away and back (only on the same tab) I should still have the same uploads running the whole time, and I should be able to see all my running uploads in the card. 

c) Looks to me like I can, in fact, close/destroy the tab while an upload is running with no warning. Address.
